name: Roche site in Rotkreuz
products: fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems

sources.evidence: Roche's official Rotkreuz site page states that research, development and production take place at the site and that Roche Diagnostics International is Switzerland's largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems; the current careers page reports 33 diagnostic instruments and four laboratory automation systems manufactured there.
Roche's current Rotkreuz careers page identifies manufacturing as a core area and reports more than 700 manufacturing employees.

name: Novo Nordisk production site in Kalundborg
products: active pharmaceutical ingredients for diabetes and obesity

sources.evidence: Novo Nordisk's official 2025 Form 20-F lists Kalundborg, Denmark among its major production facilities, with active pharmaceutical ingredients for diabetes and obesity and diabetes-care products as major production activities.
Novo Nordisk's current manufacturing page identifies Site Kalundborg as part of its Global Manufacturing & Supply network in Denmark.

Ericsson's official Estonia page states that its own production site was acquired in 2009, that production at Ericsson Supply Site Tallinn runs 24/7, and that the site industrializes Ericsson Radio Systems portfolio products and produces prototype builds and test hardware.

name: Liebherr-Transportation Systems Marica EOOD, Radinovo
products: thermal management systems for rail vehicles

sources.evidence: Liebherr's official Bulgaria location page lists Liebherr-Transportation Systems Marica EOOD at Radinovo, Bulgaria.

Liebherr's official production-network announcement states that Liebherr-Transportation Systems Marica EOOD is already involved in production of air-conditioning and thermal-management systems for the rail industry and cold-chain logistics in the Plovdiv area.

name: Thermo Fisher Scientific Baltics UAB Vilnius manufacturing site
